title: Shopify GraphQL throttling and access errors arrive with HTTP 200, so res.ok checks treat them as success
symptoms: HTTP 200 with errors[0].extensions.code THROTTLED and data null
Sync jobs report success while writing nothing during a burst
ACCESS_DENIED or protected data errors appear only inside the JSON body
cause: The GraphQL Admin API returns most failures, including throttling, as a 200 response with an errors array, unlike REST which uses 429 and 4xx codes.
fix: Inspect the errors array on every response, retry THROTTLED after waiting for the bucket to refill, and pace requests from extensions.cost.throttleStatus.
affected: GraphQL Admin API, all current versions
